description.default: A standalone todo board in a SiYuan tab: tasks with status flow, groups and tags, archive by year, batch operations, history import and a 7-day summary.
description.zh-CN: 独立任务看板（页签内）：待办状态流转、分组与标签、按年归档、批量操作、历史清单导入、近7天汇总，可一键生成并跳转思源文档。
